parameters.query:
INSERT INTO iteration_counter (workflow_key, run_key, iterations)
VALUES ($1, $2, 1)
ON CONFLICT (workflow_key, run_key) DO UPDATE
  SET iterations = iteration_counter.iterations + 1,
      updated_at = now()
RETURNING iterations, started_at,
  (extract(epoch from (now() - started_at)) * 1000)::bigint AS elapsed_ms;

INSERT INTO breaker_state (workflow_key, state, reason, tripped_at, tripped_by)
VALUES ($1, 'open', $2, now(), $3)
ON CONFLICT (workflow_key) DO UPDATE
  SET state = 'open', reason = EXCLUDED.reason, tripped_at = now(),
      tripped_by = EXCLUDED.tripped_by, reset_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
RETURNING workflow_key, state, reason, tripped_at;
